about: Listings whose trading currency differs from the one the pipeline gives them (briefs.currency). Read by api/app/universe.py: only the trading currency changes (price, market cap, EPS, book value, portfolio groups); statements and dividends keep the pipeline's currency.
sources: Audit reference check, docs/data-audit-2026-10-18.md F5: stockanalysis.com quote pages give each of these five as 'Price in USD' (2026-10-18).

The pipeline's own scraped ratio pages (evidence.sqlite, artifacts, artifact_type 'ratios'): market cap in 'مليون دولار' and book value in 'دولار' for all five; EPS in 'دولار' (ABC.BH, ARIG.BH) or 'سنتا', cents (GFH.DU, INOVEST, ITHMR.BH).
not_checked: Bahrain Bourse's own pages were not read: its site asked for a human verification.
